TC-13/S13.title: What reaches the next day without an import (one-line summary card)
TC-13/S13.detail: Dev: after a live Generate on a chart with only an unmarked stored note, nextPreRoundSummary is set and Pre-Round shows 'Carried Forward from Last Finished Note' with it, with no paste/photo; the unmarked note stayed unextracted; another chart does not show it. Tim's lane-A titles store a note with a billing template and were not run locally (RULES); the archived-transcript half is covered by the local S12 run (archived as yesterday's transcript). Recorded: the summary starts 'Oct 19:' though it was generated 04:27 JST Oct 20 (UTC day).
